title: Machine learning identifies a Ce-doped green-emitting phosphor
summary: XGBoost screening of measured Ce substitution sites guided synthesis of Ca2SrSc6O12:Ce3+, reported to show blue excitation and green emission. This is a laboratory phosphor result, not a commercial LED demonstration. The 2026 journal version describes revised data; its exact mapping to this preprint result is unresolved, so this record is bounded to the arXiv v1 claim.

evidence.tested: Ca2SrSc6O12:Ce3+ was synthesized and its excitation/emission measured.
evidence.unknown: Journal-version result mapping and earlier conference disclosure are unresolved.
evidence.ai_role: Model predicted Ce excitation energy and guided human selection for synthesis.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
